title: Enzo · Your clever assistant for Mac
excerpt: Enzo is an AI assistant for your Mac. It sits in on your meetings, types what you say and remembers what you worked on. Free, with 5,000 dictated words and 60 meeting minutes a week, and your history stays on your Mac.
content_html:
Talk instead of typing, get notes from your meetings, and ask it anything about your work. Enzo lives in your Mac’s notch.

Knows exactly who said what.

Enzo records the meetings you choose and tells every person apart by their voice, on a call or around one mic in a room. Ask about the call while it’s on, and the notes say who said what. The transcript is ready seconds after the call ends.

  • Zoom, Meet, Teams and FaceTime
  • Who said what, by name
  • Ask about the call while it’s on

Learn more

Remembers what you worked on.

Turn on Recall and Enzo keeps the apps, window titles and text on your screen, encrypted on your Mac, so you can find any of it again and Chat can answer from it. Passwords, API keys and card numbers are hidden before anything is kept.

  • Off until you turn it on
  • No screenshots kept
  • Pause it, or keep apps and sites out

      • Stays on your Mac

        Recordings, transcripts, chats, voice profiles and Recall. Never synced or backed up to our servers.

      • Goes to the cloud

        What you ask Chat with what’s needed to answer it, and a finished meeting’s transcript for its notes. Our service keeps none of it, and the AI provider keeps it only briefly to check for abuse.

        Enzo reads only the apps you connect, and Recall is off until you turn it on. Settings shows what its AI does on its own.

      • Works offline

        Dictation, recording and transcription need no internet. Only the AI does.

      Enzo is free for as long as you like. Plus and Pro give you more dictation, more meeting notes and more AI.

      • Recall, every day written up
      • Inbox watched all day

      14-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime.

      For all-day work

      Unlimited dictation and meetings, and three times Plus’s AI.

      $16.67a month, billed $200 yearly

      • Unlimited dictation
      • Unlimited meetings
      • 3× Plus’s AI
      • Answers from all your history
      • Recall, every day written up
      • Inbox watched all day

      14-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime.

      Every plan connects all your apps, runs your routines, and drafts replies for you to send from your mail app.

      Limits reset every week. How limits work

      You choose a plan in the app.

      Questions

      Does Enzo upload my recordings or Recall?

      No. Recordings, transcripts, chats, voice profiles and Recall are stored on your Mac, and never synced or backed up to our servers. Transcription runs on your Mac too, so audio never leaves it. Enzo’s AI runs in the cloud. A question to Chat sends the question and what’s needed to answer it, chosen on your Mac: text, and a picture of your screen or of an attached file when text isn’t enough. After a meeting, Enzo sends the transcript to write its notes, and a follow-up can also send related mail, chats and Recall. It sends short details from the apps you connect to keep track of your inbox and calendar. Our service keeps none of it, and the AI provider keeps it only briefly to check for abuse. Settings › Privacy shows what goes. Turn it off there or in Connections.

      How fast is dictation?

      About a tenth of a second from when you stop talking to your words as text, for a typical dictation. Enzo transcribes on your Mac while you speak, so little is left when you stop: a seven-minute dictation is ready in about a quarter of a second, and an hour-long one in about two (M4 Mac, measured November 2026).

      What is free?

      Free has no time limit. Each week you get 5,000 dictated words and 60 meeting minutes with notes. Past the words, dictation waits until the week resets; past the minutes, meeting recording does. Chat answers at Low effort from today and your last working day, and AI usage renews every week. Every connected app works on Free. One Free account per Mac login.

      Can I get my money back?

      Yes. Write to hello@tryenzo.ai within 14 days of your first payment for a full refund, on Plus or Pro. You can also cancel anytime in Enzo, in Settings, Billing, and your plan stays until the end of the period you paid for.

      Which Macs are supported?

      Apple Silicon Macs, M1 or newer, with macOS 15 or later. On a screen without a notch, Enzo sits at the top of the screen, or on a small island you can move to any edge.

      Do I need an account?

      Yes. A free Enzo account signs you in, applies your plan and measures your AI usage across your Macs. Sign in with Apple, Google or a code sent to your email. The account holds no recordings or history.

      All questions

      Start today with Enzo.

      Free, with no time limit. Plus is $10 a month when you want more.

      Download for MacFor Macs with Apple silicon on macOS 15 or later.

      问题

      Does Enzo upload my recordings or Recall?

      No. Recordings, transcripts, chats, voice profiles and Recall are stored on your Mac, and never synced or backed up to our servers. Transcription runs on your Mac too, so audio never leaves it. Enzo’s AI runs in the cloud. A question to Chat sends the question and what’s needed to answer it, chosen on your Mac: text, and a picture of your screen or of an attached file when text isn’t enough. After a meeting, Enzo sends the transcript to write its notes, and a follow-up can also send related mail, chats and Recall. It sends short details from the apps you connect to keep track of your inbox and calendar. Our service keeps none of it, and the AI provider keeps it only briefly to check for abuse. Settings › Privacy shows what goes. Turn it off there or in Connections.

      How fast is dictation?

      About a tenth of a second from when you stop talking to your words as text, for a typical dictation. Enzo transcribes on your Mac while you speak, so little is left when you stop: a seven-minute dictation is ready in about a quarter of a second, and an hour-long one in about two (M4 Mac, measured November 2026).

      What is free?

      Free has no time limit. Each week you get 5,000 dictated words and 60 meeting minutes with notes. Past the words, dictation waits until the week resets; past the minutes, meeting recording does. Chat answers at Low effort from today and your last working day, and AI usage renews every week. Every connected app works on Free. One Free account per Mac login.

      Can I get my money back?

      是的。 Write to hello@tryenzo.ai within 14 days of your first payment for a full refund, on Plus or Pro. You can also cancel anytime in Enzo, in Settings, Billing, and your plan stays until the end of the period you paid for.

      Which Macs are supported?

      Apple Silicon Macs, M1 or newer, with macOS 15 or later. On a screen without a notch, Enzo sits at the top of the screen, or on a small island you can move to any edge.

      Do I need an account?

      是的。 A free Enzo account signs you in, applies your plan and measures your AI usage across your Macs. Sign in with Apple, Google or a code sent to your email. The account holds no recordings or history.
